title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: Little product-specific signal this week: RSV mentions rose to 29 from 17, mostly social posts about multi-vaccine shot days, with no high-relevance news or official items on infant RSV antibodies.
products.implication: The infant RSV conversation is ticking up but is not yet tied to any policy decision or media story in the past 72 hours, so there is nothing new to react to.
products.action: Keep infant-RSV issue materials and stakeholder contacts current, and keep monitoring parent conversation for any care-centre cluster or access questions that could escalate.
who: Obstetric clinics and postpartum care centres
products.signal_zh: 本週產品相關訊號少：RSV聲量由17升至29，多為同日接種多劑疫苗的社群貼文，無嬰幼兒RSV抗體相關高相關新聞或官方訊息。
products.implication_zh: 嬰幼兒RSV討論略有升溫，但近72小時尚未連結任何政策決定或媒體報導，目前無新議題需回應。
products.action_zh: 持續更新嬰幼兒RSV議題資料及利害關係人聯繫名單，並持續監測家長討論，留意可能升溫的托嬰中心群聚或取得管道問題。
who_zh: 兒科及新生兒科醫學會
婦產科診所及產後護理之家

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), enhanced flu, public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: Doctors quoted in several outlets link flu in older adults to stroke, disability and cardiovascular risk and mention adjuvanted or high-dose options, while enhanced-vaccine volume fell (hd 11 vs 15; enhanced 25 vs 44). Funding is not stated in these pieces, and Taiwan CDC's reported 500,000-dose flu top-up does not specify vaccine type.
products.implication: The enhanced-vaccine story now rests on clinician commentary rather than programme news, so questions may arise over whether top-ups or second-stage eligibility will include enhanced doses beyond long-term care residents.
products.action: Prepare an evidence and supply briefing for Taiwan CDC on the first enhanced-vaccine season, covering long-term care uptake and any top-up needs. Check that any clinician-facing activity stays scientific and non-promotional under Taiwan's prescription-medicine advertising rules.
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），加強型流感疫苗，公費對象為65歲以上長照機構住民
products.signal_zh: 多家媒體引述醫師指出，長者感染流感與中風、失能及心血管風險相關，並提及佐劑型或高劑量疫苗；但加強型疫苗聲量下降（高劑量11對15；加強型25對44）。相關報導未說明經費來源，疾管署據報追加的50萬劑流感疫苗亦未說明疫苗類型。
products.implication_zh: 加強型疫苗議題目前仰賴臨床醫師評論而非計畫消息，可能引發追加採購或第二階段資格是否將加強型疫苗擴及長照機構住民以外對象的疑問。
products.action_zh: 為疾管署準備首個加強型疫苗接種季的實證與供應簡報，涵蓋長照機構接種情形及追加需求。確保任何針對臨床醫師的活動符合台灣處方藥廣告規範，維持科學性且不具宣傳性質。
who_zh: 老年醫學及感染症醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.sub: pertussis booster for adolescents and adults
products.signal: Little signal: Tdap volume was flat at 6 mentions, and the only related storyline is an earlier medical-society call for vaccinations among people with chronic lung disease, with nothing new in the past 72 hours.
products.implication: Tdap is absent from the current flu and COVID-19 campaign news cycle, so there is no near-term issue pressure.
products.action: Maintain relationships with the respiratory societies that raised chronic-lung-disease vaccination and keep pertussis issue materials ready in case case reports surface.
products.sub_zh: 青少年及成人百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 訊號少：Tdap聲量持平於6則，唯一相關議題為先前醫學會呼籲慢性肺病患者接種疫苗，近72小時無新進展。
products.implication_zh: Tdap未出現在當前流感及COVID-19接種新聞中，短期內無議題壓力。
products.action_zh: 維繫與提出慢性肺病患者接種議題之呼吸道相關醫學會的關係，並備妥百日咳議題資料，以因應可能出現的病例報導。
who_zh: 胸腔暨重症相關醫學會

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: protein-based, distributed in Taiwan by Sanofi, public programme from 19 October
products.signal: Taiwan CDC announced Novavax will be added to the public programme from 19 October and said it plans additional Novavax doses. Wide media pickup followed, focusing on its different manufacturing process and on who is eligible.
products.implication: Launch week puts Novavax in the spotlight, with likely scrutiny of site availability, eligibility rules and early safety reports, all against a backdrop of recirculating COVID-19 safety misinformation.
products.action: Run launch-week issue readiness. Align factual eligibility and supply information with Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus, prepare holding statements on distribution and adverse-event questions, and monitor fact-check outlets for claims attaching to the product.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質次單位疫苗，台灣由賽諾菲代理，10月19日起納入公費
products.signal_zh: 疾管署宣布Novavax自10月19日起納入公費計畫，並表示規劃增購Novavax疫苗。媒體廣泛報導，聚焦其不同製程及接種資格。
products.implication_zh: 開打首週Novavax成為焦點，接種點供應、資格規定及早期安全性通報可能受到檢視，且背景為COVID-19安全性不實資訊再度流傳。
products.action_zh: 做好開打首週議題準備。與疾管署及地方衛生局對齊接種資格及供應的事實資訊，備妥配送及不良事件問題的回應聲明，並監測事實查核機構是否出現涉及本產品的說法。

issues.title: Novavax public COVID-19 rollout first week
issues.note: Coverage is heavy on eligibility; expect questions on which sites stock it, early uptake figures and any adverse-event posts, and on the additional Novavax doses Taiwan CDC said it plans.
issues.note_zh: 報導多聚焦接種資格；預期將出現哪些接種點有供應、早期接種數據及不良事件貼文等問題，以及疾管署所稱規劃增購之Novavax疫苗。

issues.title: Second-stage public flu eligibility amid top-up orders
issues.note: With flu vaccinations reported between 2.26 and 3.15 million and a reported 500,000-dose top-up, scrutiny of supply adequacy and of the enhanced versus standard mix may intensify as more groups become eligible.
issues.title_zh: 追加採購下的第二階段公費流感疫苗接種資格
issues.note_zh: 流感疫苗接種量據報介於226萬至315萬劑，另據報追加50萬劑，隨著更多族群符合資格，對供應是否充足及加強型與標準型疫苗配比的檢視可能升溫。

issues.title: COVID-19 safety misinformation recirculating during campaign
issues.note: A debunked autopsy claim is circulating again, and an article claimed side effects of next-generation COVID-19 vaccines were halved. Either could attach to the new rollout, so keep fact-based responses ready with official sources.
issues.title_zh: 接種期間COVID-19安全性不實資訊再度流傳
issues.note_zh: 已遭駁斥的解剖說法再度流傳，另有文章宣稱新一代COVID-19疫苗副作用減半。兩者皆可能連結到新疫苗開打，應備妥以官方資料為據的事實回應。

self_pay.title: Little direct self-pay signal this week
self_pay.note: Nothing in the past 72 hours covers clinic stock, prices or promotion in the self-pay market for enhanced flu vaccines, RSV infant antibodies or Tdap. Almost all coverage concerns the public programme.
self_pay.title_zh: 本週自費市場直接訊號少
self_pay.note_zh: 近72小時無關於加強型流感疫苗、嬰幼兒RSV抗體或Tdap自費市場之診所庫存、價格或推廣的報導。幾乎所有報導皆聚焦公費計畫。

self_pay.title: Enhanced-flu commentary with funding unstated
self_pay.note: Doctor-led pieces urging older adults to consider adjuvanted or high-dose flu vaccines do not say whether these are publicly funded or self-paid. Watch whether older adults outside the first-priority long-term care group begin asking clinics about self-pay access.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型流感疫苗評論未說明經費來源
self_pay.note_zh: 醫師主導、呼籲長者考慮佐劑型或高劑量流感疫苗的報導，未說明為公費或自費。留意第一優先長照機構對象以外的長者是否開始向診所詢問自費接種。
